current.text: Jackson is set to start at center for the Clippers over Brook Lopez. He started over Lopez in preseason scrimmages and told reporters he is starting.
Yanic Konan Niederhauser, another Clippers center, is out injured.
The starting job may not last all season. It likely lasts only until Konan Niederhauser returns, so his value should fade later in the year.
He is worth a late flyer in every 12-team league and can be top 150 early in the season. One expert sees a longer leash for him than for Jalen Smith.
His upside is a starter at about 25 minutes with a big FG% boost, blocks and solid rebounds.
Foul trouble is a risk to his minutes as a starter.
The Clippers expect a trial season with long rotations and many players tested. Coach Ty Lue often changes his rotation choices.
The Clippers play 4, 3 and 4 games in our playoff weeks and have one of the lowest back-to-back totals in the league with 13.

durable.text: He makes no threes and never became a three-point shooter.
He tore his Achilles two years ago.
He got hurt at the end of last season after a strong late run.
He is not a very good NBA player. His fantasy value depends on starter minutes.
Clippers coach Ty Lue never gives his centers heavy minutes.
